note: Float census of orthogonal-row frames, not a theorem, and it does not close Milestone E. Accepted frames have finite positive leverages, aat_err below 1e-8, and leverage ratio and normalized coherence fitting at least one cell τ in {2, 4, 8}, ρ in {0.5, 0.7, 0.9}. The known adverse family is leverage-unbalanced and is not in this sample.
